description: This file defines an Android Activity that allows the user to select different screen orientation modes through a dropdown menu (Spinner). When a selection is made, the activity's orientation is changed accordingly. The list of orientations is predefined in an array and corresponds to various constants in the Android ActivityInfo class.

classes.name: ScreenOrientation
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides a UI to select and set different screen orientations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout and spinner, and defines the behavior when a new orientation is selected.
